description: (Cockpit series v0.7) 01_RP_Regionalplan_fuer_den_Planungsraum_I_in_Schleswig-Holstein_Kapitel_5.8_Windenergie_an_Land_2020-12-31 is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by sh.xplanungsplattform.de. On 31. In December 2020, the partial list of the regional plan for planning room I on the subject of onshore wind energy entered into force. The planning space includes the district-free city of Flensburg as well as the districts of Nordfriesland and Schleswig-Flensburg. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "(Cockpit series v0.7) 01_RP_Regional plan_fuer_den_Planning area_I_in_Schleswig-Holstein_Chapter_5.8_Wind energy_an_Land" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include XPlanung, opendata. The listing shows 2 download or service links in WFS, WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://dcat-ap.de/def/licenses/dl-by-de/2.0). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
